description: This file contains a Python implementation of a utility for managing OpenSSL certificates, including classes for creating and handling a local CA, generating host certificates, and configuring OpenSSL commands.

classes.name: OpenSSL
classes.description: A context manager class for interacting with OpenSSL, creating configuration files, and running OpenSSL commands.

classes.name: OpenSSLEnvironment
classes.description: A class that manages a local CA and host certificates using OpenSSL, including creation, validation, and regeneration logic.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the OpenSSL or OpenSSLEnvironment object with configuration parameters.

methods.name: __enter__
methods.description: Sets up necessary files and directories for the SSL environment or context.

methods.name: __exit__
methods.description: Cleans up temporary directories if used.

methods.name: ca_cert_path
methods.description: Returns the path to the CA certificate, generating a new one if necessary.

methods.name: _load_ca_cert
methods.description: Loads existing CA certificate and key if valid.

methods.name: check_key_cert
methods.description: Checks if a key and certificate file exist and are valid (not expired).

methods.name: _generate_ca
methods.description: Generates a new CA key and certificate.

methods.name: host_cert_path
methods.description: Returns paths for a host's key and certificate, generating new ones if needed.

methods.name: _load_host_cert
methods.description: Loads existing host key and certificate if valid.

methods.name: _generate_host_cert
methods.description: Generates a new key and certificate for a host.
